summary: The new native hook does not match the interface-qualified method name compiled for cl_http_utility, so decode_base64 still reaches NOT_COMPILED kernel stubs. The added UTF-8 decoder also disagrees with Node on malformed sequences, including cases where it drops valid text.

findings.claim: The NATIVE map key omits IF_HTTP_UTILITY~. The pinned cl_http_utility implementation defines METHOD if_http_utility~decode_base64, so the compiler emits its two @KERNEL stubs instead of abap.DecodeBase64; calling cl_http_utility=>decode_base64 remains NOT_COMPILED.

The decoder skips all remaining bytes when a UTF-8 lead expects more bytes than remain, without checking whether they are continuations, and it does not combine a valid incomplete prefix before a noncontinuation. For decoded bytes E4 41 it drops the valid A (Node returns �A); for E4 BD 41 it produces ��A (Node returns �A).
findings.repro: Compare DecodeBase64(&Session{}, "5EE=") and DecodeBase64(&Session{}, "5L1B") with Node's Buffer.from(encoded, "base64").toString(): Go returns "�" and "��A", while Node returns "�A" for both.
